Package main.java.progOO2.p20

package main.java.progOO2.p20

Programming Object Oriented II: Library

This package demonstrates how to create objects, store them in an ArrayList, and display information about those objects based on user input. The exercise uses books as the main example.

Classes:

  • Book represents a book with a title, number of pages, and publication year. It provides a getter for the book title and overrides toString() to display all book information.
  • Library contains the main method. It reads book information from the user, stores the books in an ArrayList, and allows the user to choose whether to display all information or only the book names.

Key learning goals:

  • Classes and objects: Creating Book objects from information entered by the user.
  • Collections: Managing multiple Book objects inside an ArrayList.
  • User input: Reading and processing book information using Scanner.
  • Conditional logic: Selecting the information to display based on the user's choice.
  • Encapsulation: Keeping book attributes private and providing a getter for the book name.
  • Object representation: Using toString() to provide a readable representation of a Book object.

This exercise strengthens the ability to combine classes, objects, collections, user input, and conditional statements in a small interactive Java application.
